canon: Bestia grande y pesada, de piel gris ceniza curtida bajo una coraza natural de placas óseas gruesas y blanquecinas que se solapan como escamas; costillas visibles bajo la piel cuando respira hondo, andar lento y pisadas que tiemblan en el suelo. Reptil herbívoro del tamaño de una casa, con placas óseas volcánicas. Solo se caza de adulta con lanzas de hueso, en cacerías serias.

prompt.sujeto: A huge, heavy, four-legged armoured beast with a barrel-shaped body, a heavy head carried low and four thick, wrinkled, pillar-like legs ending in broad, round feet.
prompt.proporcion: The body is one and three quarters as long as it is deep, the head is half as long, and each leg is about half as thick as the body is deep.
prompt.cuerpo: Below the slabs the flanks are dark umber-grey hide, wrinkled into deep, parallel, vertical ribbed grooves like a corrugated wall. The legs and belly are dark grey-brown.
rasgos: Thick, pitted slabs of pale, sandy bone-cream armour, each a different size with rough edges and sharp spikes, stand edge-on along the spine and angle up and backward, forming a jagged ridge, with smaller slabs stacked over the shoulders and hips like roof tiles.
The largest slab is a wide, flaring, spiked shield that covers the top of the head.
A thick, curved, dark horn rises from each side of the lower jaw, a long, curved horn rises from the snout, and the small eyes sit deep under the plated brow.
prompt.rasgosSecundarios: The slabs are cream-beige and grey with darker stains in their pits, and the horns are dark brown-grey.
prompt.pose: Seen from a low camera angle, the body in full side profile, it walks mid-stride with one front foot lifted and its heavy head low, turned slightly toward the viewer with both eyes showing.
prompt.manada: Behind it, smaller and hazier with distance, two more beasts plod along, each one a huge, heavy, four-legged armoured beast with a barrel-shaped body, a jagged ridge of pale bone slabs along the spine, a wide spiked shield over the head and a long curved horn on the snout.
prompt.entorno: The ground is cracked red earth, and heavy red dust rises around the feet of the beasts; a wall of red sandstone cliffs stands on the right, low mesas on the left horizon, and a faint herd of the same beasts walks far off on the plain.
prompt.luz: The low sun sits at the left horizon under a golden-orange sky streaked with thin clouds, and its warm light rims the bone slabs and horns while the drifting dust glows orange and a red-orange haze tints the earth.

rasgos+: This male is heavier in the head and shoulders, with longer horns and a wider shield over the head.
This female is slightly smaller and slighter, with shorter horns and a narrower shield over the head.

momento:noche.luz: Deep blue night under a sky full of stars with a soft, even pearly glow, and a cool silver-blue light rims the bone slabs and horns while the drifting dust glows faintly.

propuestas: diseño de la imagen del juego (usuaria, 2026-10-26: «todo lo que hay ahora en las imágenes es lo que me gustaría igualar»); donde choca con el canon, va como propuesta de lore

choca con el canon: losas óseas de canto en cresta dentada (el canon: placas que se solapan como escamas), flancos acanalados como chapa ondulada, tres cuernos (uno a cada lado de la mandíbula y uno largo en el hocico) y lámina espinosa sobre la cabeza, colores beige crema y marrón umbra (el canon: piel gris ceniza y placas blanquecinas)

capas.corto: A single huge heavy armoured reptile, full body in three-quarter view walking toward the left of the camera, centre of the frame, head low. Low warm sun from the left. It has the body of a rhinoceros the size of a house, with four thick pillar legs and wrinkled elephant-like feet. Rough pale bone plates, like a stack of broken tiles, rise on its back as a jagged crest and cover its head as a wide shield. Three long horns like a buffalo's, curving up, sprout from its snout and jaw. Its dark grey flank is ribbed like corrugated sheet. Two more of the same walk beside it. Cracked red earth, red cliffs.
capas.sujeto: A single huge heavy armoured reptile, seen in full body in three-quarter view, walking slowly toward the viewer's right with its head low, standing in the centre of the image and filling most of the image height.
capas.luz: Low warm golden sun from the left, near the horizon: the top edges of the bone plates and the back are lit, the flank, underside and legs fall into deep shadow, and the dust kicked up around the feet glows orange.
capas.tamano: As tall and as long as a two-storey house; each leg as thick as an old tree trunk; far bigger than the two others beside it, which are about two thirds its size, and than the herd on the horizon.
capas.forma: The body of a rhinoceros with a barrel of ribs and four thick pillar legs, ending in broad round feet with wrinkled skin like an elephant's. The flank is ribbed with deep parallel grooves, like corrugated metal sheet. A jagged crest of large pale bone slabs and spikes, like broken roof tiles set on edge, runs along the back and shoulders, and a wide spiked bone shield covers the top of the head and neck. A heavy head carried low, with a deep mouth showing teeth. Three long horns that sweep up and forward like a buffalo's: one on each side of the jaw and one longer one on the snout.
capas.entorno: In the foreground, red clay earth cracked like a dry lake bed. In the middle distance, a haze of orange dust at the feet of the beasts and a flat plain. On the right, a tall red sandstone cliff, and on the horizon a distant herd of more of the same, tiny, under a golden sky with thin clouds and the low sun on the left.
capas.color: Dark grey-brown wrinkled hide, dusty; pale beige-cream bone plates, stained darker brown in their cracks and chipped at the tips; pale ivory horns tipped with dark grey; red-brown cracked earth; orange dust; red cliff.
capas.repetir: Beside it, two more of the same beasts, about two thirds its size, walking the same way; far behind, a herd of many more, tiny and hazy on the horizon.
capas.paleta: bone beige, dark grey-brown and rust red with one accent of golden orange
capas.notas: IMG-55, escrita mirando el banner. Macho (cabeza y hombros pesados, cuernos largos). Diferencias con el canon: placas en cresta dentada de losas de canto y púas, no 'solapadas como escamas'; escudo óseo sobre la cabeza; tres cuernos largos curvos hacia arriba (como de búfalo, uno a cada lado de la mandíbula y uno en el hocico); flancos acanalados como chapa ondulada (el canon: 'costillas visibles'); color beige crema y pardo (el canon: piel gris ceniza y placas blanquecinas); suelo de arcilla roja agrietada y acantilado rojo, no 'ceniza'; manada de dos cerca y muchas lejos. Se quita 'ivory-yellow' (vetado): marfil solo como 'pale ivory'.
